query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_entries,
  SUM(CASE WHEN aiProcessedAt IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as identified,
  SUM(CASE WHEN aiProcessedAt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unidentified,
  MAX(aiProcessedAt) as last_identified_at,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN aiProcessedAt IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as id_rate_pct
FROM leaderboard_entries;
